annotations.text:
Workstation. Instrument, not dashboard. Warm neutral grays (#161615 / #1e1e1d / #282827), IBM Plex Sans 12px + Plex Mono 11px, sentence case everywhere, 2px radii, 28px controls, one amber accent (#e0a63f) shared by active states and the crosshair. Viewports carry a 22px header with the plane and the slice coordinate; active tabs sit flush with their panel instead of taking an underline; the primary button is inverted rather than filled blue.
Empty states are text only: a plane header with a dash, a sentence, and a mono hint.

Dropped from the current build: tracked-uppercase labels (VOLUME BUFFER EMPTY, tab names, section kickers), the filled Tailwind-blue button, blue tab underlines and the blue top stripe, navy grounds (#05080c / #0b1521), Inter, the cube and hexagon empty-state icons with 'awaiting input stream' copy, and the circular V / S badges in the scene list. Layout, the 17 / 60 / 23 panel split, and every existing control are unchanged.

B · Lightbox. Paper chrome around black plates, film on a light table. Newsreader for headings and plate captions, Source Sans for controls, one signal red for the crosshair and its readout. Slice sliders live in the caption row.
Tradeoff: light chrome beside grayscale images costs some contrast perception in a dark reading room, and it is the biggest break from what exists.
Not chosen; kept for reference.

C · Darkroom. Neutral black, hairlines instead of borders, no accent in the chrome at all: hierarchy comes from text brightness and weight, and the only color on screen belongs to the data: the crosshair and its readout. Instrument Sans + JetBrains Mono.
Tradeoff: quiet to the point of being under-signposted for a new user; the primary action relies on one inverted button.
Not chosen; kept for reference.
